<mxfile host="Electron" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) draw.io/24.7.8 Chrome/128.0.6613.36 Electron/32.0.1 Safari/537.36" version="24.7.8"> <diagram id="bMtMf2MIWwBW1xR_BM6K" name="第 1 页"> <mxGraphModel dx="1050" dy="621" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="900" pageHeight="700" background="#121212" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="TCP 连接释放 (四次挥手 Four-way Handshake)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=22;fontColor=#e5e7eb;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="150" y="30" width="600" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="client" value="客户端 (Client)
主动关闭" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#172554;strokeColor=#60a5fa;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="140" y="100" width="120" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="server" value="服务器 (Server)
被动关闭" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#022c22;strokeColor=#34d399;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="640" y="100" width="120" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="timeline_c" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#4b5563;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=1;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="200" y="150" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="660" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="timeline_s" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#4b5563;strokeWidth=1.5;dashed=1;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="150" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="660" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_c_est" value="ESTABLISHED" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#9ca3af;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="140" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_s_est" value="ESTABLISHED" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#9ca3af;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="140" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow_fin1" value="第一次挥手 (FIN 报文)
FIN = 1, seq = u" style="edgeStyle=none;html=1;strokeColor=#60a5fa;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=14;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;spacingBottom=8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="200" y="190" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="250" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_c_fw1" value="FIN_WAIT_1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#93c5fd;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="190" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow_ack1" value="第二次挥手 (ACK 报文)
ACK = 1, seq = v, ack = u + 1" style="edgeStyle=none;html=1;strokeColor=#34d399;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=14;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;spacingBottom=8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="270" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="330" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_s_cw" value="CLOSE_WAIT" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#6ee7b7;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="270" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_c_fw2" value="FIN_WAIT_2" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#93c5fd;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="330" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="server_processing" value="(服务端可能继续发送剩余数据...)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#9ca3af;fontSize=13;fontStyle=2;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="580" y="320" width="220" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow_fin2" value="第三次挥手 (FIN 报文)
FIN = 1, ACK = 1, seq = w, ack = u + 1" style="edgeStyle=none;html=1;strokeColor=#a78bfa;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=14;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;spacingBottom=8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="410" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="470" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_s_la" value="LAST_ACK" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#c4b5fd;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="410" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow_ack2" value="第四次挥手 (ACK 报文)
ACK = 1, seq = u + 1, ack = w + 1" style="edgeStyle=none;html=1;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#d1d5db;fontSize=14;align=center;verticalAlign=bottom;spacingBottom=8;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="200" y="490" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="550" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_c_tw" value="TIME_WAIT" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#fcd34d;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="490" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_s_closed" value="CLOSED" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#9ca3af;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="550" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="arrow_2msl" style="edgeStyle=none;html=1;strokeColor=#fcd34d;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;endArrow=classic;" parent="1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="200" y="520" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="600" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="label_2msl" value="等待 2MSL" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#fcd34d;fontSize=13;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="110" y="545" width="80" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="state_c_closed_final" value="CLOSED" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontColor=#9ca3af;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="600" width="100" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
